div.head: Hl 3
div.ab: Gif mannes esne frigne mannan ofslæhð, þane þe sie hund scillinga gelde, se agend þone banan agefe ⁊ oþer manwyrð þær tó.
Gif mannes esne frigne mannan ofslæhð, þane þe sie hund scillinga gelde, se agend þone banan agefe ⁊ oþer manwyrð þær tó.
If a person’s servant kills a free man, who should be compensated for with a hundred shillings, the owner should give up that killer and another man-worth in addition.
If a man’s servant slays a freeman whose wergeld is 100 shillings, his owner shall surrender the homicide and [pay] the value of another man in addition.
If a man’s servant kills a freeman, who has a wergild of 100 shillings, the owner is to give up the slayer, and the value of another man in addition.
Wenn jemandes Knecht einen freien Menschen erschlägt, einen, welcher im 100 Schilling-Wergelde steht, [so] liefere der Eigenthümer den Todtschläger aus und einen zweiten Knechtspreis dazu.
If someone’s servant slays a free person, one who stands at a 100-shilling wergeld, [then] let the owner hand over the killer and a second slave-price in addition.
